title: Told to, said that
goal: Choose -mA for requests and orders and -DIk for facts, and pass on requests with istemek and rica etmek.

intro.text: `-mA` names an action someone wants done; `-DIk` reports a fact. *Gelmemi söyledi* is **she told me to come**, *Geldiğimi söyledi* **she said I had come**. With *istemek* and *rica etmek*, the person asked takes the ablative: *Benden beklememi istedi* (She asked me to wait).

vocab.en: request, favour (Bir ricam var: I have a favour to ask)
to turn down, to lower (sesini kısmak: to turn the volume down)

exercises.question: *Annem erken gelmemi söyledi.* What did my mother say?
options: She told me to come early.
She said that I had come early.
She said she would come early.

why.1: That would be *erken geldiğimi söyledi*, with `-DIk`: a fact, not an order.
why.2: That would be *erken geleceğini söyledi*: her own plan, with `-(y)AcAk`.

exercises.explain: `-mA` + possessive with *söylemek* passes on an order: *gel-me-m-i söyledi*, **she told me to come**.

exercises.en: The doctor advised me to rest.
exercises.explain: Advice is an action to be done, so `-mA`: *dinlen-me-m-i tavsiye etti*. *Dinlendiğimi* would report a fact: that I had rested.

exercises.label: *unutmamak* + *rica etti*: she asked me not to forget, you not to forget…
exercises.explain: The negative *-ma* and the verbal noun *-ma* stand side by side, then the possessive and the accusative: *unut-ma-ma-m-ı*; for **he**, *unut-ma-ma-s-ı-n-ı*.

exercises.prompt: She asked me to come early.

reject.why: With *istemek*, the person asked takes the ablative: *benden*.
*Söylemek* is **to tell**. For **to ask**, use *istemek* or *rica etmek*, with the person in the ablative: *benden*.

exercises.explain: *Benden* (the person asked, in the ablative) + *erken gel-me-m-i istedi*.

exercises.prompt: Komşumuzdan müziğin sesini kısmasını rica ettik.
accept: We asked our neighbour to turn down the music.
We asked our neighbor to turn [down the music|the music down].
We asked our neighbour to turn the music down.
We asked our [neighbour|neighbor] to turn [down the volume|the volume down] (of the music).
We [politely|kindly] asked our [neighbour|neighbor] to turn [down the music|the music down].

exercises.en: He told me he was waiting.

exercises.question: *Kaptan herkesin gemiden inmesini emretti.* What happened?
options: The captain ordered everyone off the ship.
The captain said everyone had left the ship.
The captain left the ship before everyone else.

why.1: That would be *herkesin gemiden indiğini söyledi*: a fact, with `-DIk`.
why.2: *İnmesini* is the object of *emretti*: an order given to everyone, not something the captain did.

exercises.explain: *Emretmek* (to order) takes an action: *herkes-in in-me-s-i-n-i emretti*.

exercises.prompt: I want you to tell me the truth.
exercises.explain: Something you want done: `-mA` + your possessive + accusative, *söyle-me-n-i istiyorum*.

exercises.en: Everyone knows that Ali is right.

reject.why: *Bilmek* reports a fact, so `-DIk`: *olduğunu*. `-mA` would make it something wanted.
The clause is the object of *biliyor*: add the accusative after the n, *olduğunu*.

exercises.hint: Something everyone knows: a fact or an action?

exercises.prompt: The teacher asked us to switch off our phones.

exercises.en: I'd ask you to be quiet.

exercises.prompt: Ali bize yardım etmeyi teklif etti, ama Selin reddetti.
accept: Ali offered to help us, but Selin refused.
Ali offered to help us, but Selin [said no|turned it down|turned him down|refused it].

exercises.task: Your manager, Elif, left this voice message. Pass it on to a colleague in reported speech: facts with `-DIk` or `-(y)AcAk`, requests with `-mA` and *istedi* or *rica etti*.
exercises.source: Merhaba, ben Elif. Yarınki toplantı saat ona alındı. Lütfen raporu bu akşam bana gönderin ve Murat'a da haber verin.
models: Elif Hanım aradı. Yarınki toplantının saat ona alındığını söyledi. Raporu bu akşam ona göndermemizi ve Murat'a da haber vermemizi istedi.
Elif aradı ve toplantının yarın saat onda olacağını söyledi. Bizden raporu bu akşam kendisine göndermemizi, Murat'a da haber vermemizi rica etti.
checklist: The fact with `-DIk` or `-(y)AcAk`: *toplantının saat ona alındığını*, *saat onda olacağını*
With *istemek* or *rica etmek*, the person asked in the ablative: *bizden*
